[ Brand ]

The EEZ mark.

The gradient Ethereum bipyramid and the ETHEREUM ECONOMIC ZONE wordmark. The wordmark lives in headers and footers; the mark carries illustrations and social.

[ Do ]

Keep clear space around the lockup. Use the wordmark for headers and footers, the mark for icons and social.

[ Don’t ]

Don’t recolour the gradient, stretch, or rotate the mark. Don’t place the dark lockup on a dark ground.

[ Note ]

Always pull the current logo from this page. More formats and a full kit are planned.
